✅ Last answer: D, 62.5 g of ice left.
Water cooling to 0 °C gives 4000 cal. Warming the ice to 0 °C takes 1000 cal, leaving 3000 cal: 3000 ÷ 80 = 37.5 g melts. Not enough to melt it all, so it ends at 0 °C with 100 − 37.5 = 62.5 g of ice.

✅ Last answer: C, −0.037 V.
E° values can't be added, but ΔG° = −nFE° can: ΔG° = −1F(0.77) − 2F(−0.44) = +0.11F. For 3 electrons, E° = −0.11/3 ≈ −0.037 V.

✅ Last answer: B, X gets 1.75× as much.
The first 150 mL of each breath stays in the airways. X: 15 × (500 − 150) = 5250 mL/min. Y: 30 × (250 − 150) = 3000 mL/min. 5250 ÷ 3000 = 1.75, which is why panting is inefficient.
